jobs.title: Senior Director - FP&A
jobs.description:
Kikoff: The Fintech Powering Financial Security at Scale
Kikoff is a profitable, pre-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money.
We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially.

Why Kikoff:

This is a consumer fintech startup, and you will be working with serial entrepreneurs who have built strong consumer brands and innovative products. We value extreme ownership, clear communication, a strong sense of craftsmanship, and the desire to create lasting work and work relationships. Yes, you can build an exciting business AND have real-life real-customer impact.

About The Role

As the Senior Director of FP&A you will report to the CFO and serve as a key financial thought partner to Kikoff's leadership team as the company continues its significant and profitable growth. You will own the company's financial planning, forecasting, and analysis functions, translating complex business dynamics into actionable financial insight that drives strategic decision-making. You will work closely with the CFO and cross-functional leaders to build the financial infrastructure, analytical frameworks, and planning processes that a pre-IPO fintech company demands. The ideal candidate combines rigorous financial analysis with strong business instincts, an AI mindset, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders with clarity and confidence.

The Senior Director of FP&A will initially manage a team of 3–4, with the opportunity to grow the function as Kikoff's business continues to scale. The role will be located in our San Francisco office (in office 3 days/week).

What You Will Do:

- Own Kikoff's annual operating budget, quarterly plans, weekly/daily forecasts, and long-range financial model, ensuring they reflect business realities and support strategic decision-making

- Lead FP&A team that builds and maintains financial models that capture the unit economics, marketing acquisition/retention analytics, cohort dynamics, and revenue drivers specific to Kikoff's businesses

- Serve as a trusted financial partner to business leaders across marketing, product, engineering, and operations - translating financial data into clear guidance and actionable recommendations

- Help to define the company’s key metrics and drive alignment and adoption in close partnership with our Data team, while leveraging and pushing AI adoption

- Prepare and present executive and board-level financial reporting packages, including monthly financial reporting package, board decks, KPI dashboards, and forward-looking commentary

- Lead scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to support strategic initiatives, new product launches, and capital allocation decisions

- Partner with the Corporate Controller and accounting team to ensure alignment between financial reporting and operational forecasts

- Own the selection and development of Kikoff's planning systems and financial infrastructure, driving adoption of best-in-class tools and processes

- Support fundraising, investor relations, and M&A processes as needed, including preparation of investor materials and financial due diligence

- Build, develop, and grow a high-performing FP&A team, setting a high bar for analytical rigor, business judgment, communication and cross-functional collaboration

About You:

- 12+ years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, or a related financial discipline, with significant industry experience at a high-growth company

- Background at a late-stage or public fintech, or e-commerce / marketplace / internet company with high transaction volumes preferred

- Investment banking experience preferred — candidates with IB backgrounds who have successfully transitioned into operating FP&A roles are strongly encouraged to apply

- MBA preferred; demonstrated track record of financial leadership at a later-stage pre-IPO or newly public company strongly valued

- Experience with modern planning systems required — Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, or comparable tools; ability to own the roadmap and optimization of Kikoff's planning infrastructure

- AI-first mindset with a track record of driving cross-functional adoption of AI tools in financial analysis and planning workflows

- Demonstrated ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, compelling narratives for executive and board audiences

- Expert financial modeler with deep experience building driver-based models that capture unit economics, cohort behavior, and multi-product revenue dynamics

- Comfortable operating as a player-coach — willing to roll up sleeves on detailed analysis and models while managing and developing a growing team

- Strong communication skills to build deep, collaborative relationships across Kikoff’s teams

- High business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and a track record of building credibility and trust with senior cross-functional stakeholders

Base Range
$250,000 — $275,000 USD

We are looking for a Director of Business Growth & Strategic Partnerships to lead expansion of our financial services marketplace across key verticals including credit cards, personal loans, insurance, banking, and other consumer financial products. You will be responsible for identifying and scaling strategic partnerships, optimizing monetization performance, negotiating complex commercial agreements, and building durable relationships with leading financial institutions, affiliate partners, fintech platforms, and distribution channels.

You will lead the business team cross-functionally with Product, Design, Marketing, Data, Finance, and Engineering to shape the overall marketplace strategy roadmap and unlock new growth opportunities. This role will inherit, lead, and develop a growing business development team fully dedicated to this initiative.

The ideal candidate has experience in consumer fintech, affiliate marketplaces, lead generation ecosystems, or financial services platforms similar to companies like Credit Karma and NerdWallet.

Responsibilities

Marketplace Growth Strategy

- Own the growth strategy and commercial roadmap for the financial services marketplace across categories such as credit cards, personal loans, insurance, banking, and adjacent fintech products

- Identify new revenue opportunities, partnership models, and distribution channels to expand marketplace monetization

- Develop scalable frameworks for partner acquisition, lifecycle management, and revenue optimization

- Drive strategic initiatives that improve marketplace efficiency, user conversion, LTV, and partner ROI

- Evaluate competitive trends, market dynamics, and emerging fintech opportunities to inform long-term strategy

Strategic Partnerships & Business Development

- Source, negotiate, and close high-value partnerships with banks, lenders, insurance carriers, fintechs, affiliate networks, and lead buyers

- Structure complex commercial agreements including CPA, CPL, rev-share, hybrid monetization, and exclusive distribution partnerships

- Own executive-level partner relationships and serve as the primary escalation point for strategic accounts

- Lead negotiations across pricing, economics, data-sharing, compliance requirements, marketing placements, and operational integrations

- Expand wallet share within existing partnerships through upsell, cross-sell, and new product expansion initiatives

- Build repeatable outbound and partnership sourcing strategies to drive sustained marketplace growth

Marketplace Operations & Optimization

- Oversee onboarding, launch, tracking implementation, and operational readiness for new partners

- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to improve marketplace infrastructure, attribution systems, lead routing, and optimization tooling

- Drive experimentation across placement strategy, conversion funnels, pricing models, and user segmentation

- Establish scalable operational processes and performance management systems for the partnerships organization

- Ensure partner compliance, quality standards, and operational SLAs are maintained

Analytics & Revenue Performance

- Own core marketplace KPIs including revenue growth, contribution margin, conversion rates, EPCs, CAC efficiency, approval rates, and partner retention

- Build forecasting models and business cases to evaluate partnership opportunities and investment decisions

- Analyze marketplace performance data to identify optimization opportunities, risks, and growth levers

- Deliver regular executive reporting and strategic recommendations to leadership

- Use data-driven insights to prioritize initiatives and allocate resources effectively

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, Data, Finance, and Engineering to align marketplace priorities

- Translate partner needs and market insights into product and platform improvements

- Influence roadmap prioritization to support monetization and marketplace scalability

- Collaborate with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure adherence to financial services regulations and advertising standards

- Align acquisition, lifecycle, and monetization strategies across the broader business

Team Leadership

- Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing business development and partnerships team

- Establish performance expectations, operational rigor, and career development frameworks

- Create a culture of ownership, analytical thinking, and commercial excellence

- Coach managers and individual contributors on negotiation strategy, partner management, and business execution

Requirements

- 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, growth, affiliate marketing, marketplace strategy, or related commercial functions

- 3+ years of leadership experience managing high-performing partnerships or revenue teams

- Deep experience within consumer fintech, financial services marketplaces, affiliate ecosystems, lead generation, or digital acquisition channels

- Strong understanding of financial products including credit cards, personal loans, insurance, banking products, and/or adjacent fintech categories

- Proven track record of negotiating and scaling complex strategic partnerships that drive measurable revenue growth

- Strong analytical and operational skillset with experience managing KPIs, forecasting, attribution, and monetization performance

- Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, Marketing, and Analytics teams

- Exceptional executive communication, relationship management, and negotiation skills

- Ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments

- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or relevant advanced degree is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience at a fintech marketplace, affiliate network, comparison platform, or performance marketing company

- Familiarity with CPA/CPL/rev-share monetization models and affiliate tracking platforms

- Experience managing partnerships with banks, lenders, insurance carriers, or major financial institutions

- Strong understanding of consumer acquisition funnels, lifecycle marketing, and marketplace economics

- Experience scaling partnership organizations from early-stage growth through operational maturity

- Monitor the competitive landscape and identify new technologies, channels, and partnership opportunities to accelerate Kikoff’s distribution and impact

- Act as the voice of the customer, surfacing insights that inform product development and go-to-market strategy

What We’re Looking For

- Experience creating and executing account growth plans in B2B, SaaS, or fintech environments.

jobs.title: Marketing Compliance Lead, Spanish Bilingual
jobs.location: Phoenix, Arizona, United States, San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
Kikoff: The Fintech Powering Financial Security at Scale
Kikoff is a profitable, pre-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money.
We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially.

Why Kikoff:

This is a consumer fintech startup, and you will be working with serial entrepreneurs who have built strong consumer brands and innovative products. We value extreme ownership, clear communication, a strong sense of craftsmanship, and the desire to create lasting work and work relationships. Yes, you can build an exciting business AND have real-life real-customer impact.

About the Role

Kikoff's growth depends on marketing that moves fast and connects with our customers. At the same time, our marketing must be accurate, substantiated, properly disclosed, and approved. Reporting to the Head of Compliance, you will be the person who makes both happen in English and in Spanish.

This is not just a reviewer seat. We are hiring a builder and owner of marketing compliance and a shared system of record with AI-assisted review that will keep pace with the speedy marketing team. You will lead that build.

What You'll Do

- Own marketing compliance end to end by enforcing the standards, review, claims substantiation, records, monitoring, and tooling and set the roadmap for it with the Head of Compliance.

- Review consumer-facing material in English and Spanish across channels, including paid social and search, email and SMS, landing pages and web, in-app and onboarding flows, app store listings, direct mail, affiliate and influencer content, customer support guidance, and partner collateral.

- Review Spanish creative on its own terms, ensuring disclosures are equivalent in meaning and prominence to their English counterparts and that legal terminology is rendered correctly rather than literally.

- Take the lead on developing Kikoff's AI-assisted marketing review capability and partner with Legal, Marketing, and Engineering to build it, including the ground truth it depends on and how it is evaluated before it is trusted.

- Maintain the policies, procedures, risk tiering, disclosure standards, and channel playbooks, and keep review records to satisfy examiners, auditors, and bank partners.

What We're Looking For

- Full professional fluency in Spanish and English, with the ability to review, edit, and give written compliance guidance on financial marketing copy in both. This is a working requirement of the role, assessed in an interview.

- 6+ years in compliance, legal, or regulatory review in consumer financial services, including 4+ years directly reviewing and approving consumer marketing and advertising at a bank, fintech, lender, or similarly regulated consumer brand.

- Experience owning a marketing review function or program, not just a queue.  Demonstrated high-volume review at speed, and the ability to speak to how you kept quality from slipping as throughput went up.

- Experience driving automation of a review process and the appetite to specify AI tooling; having built or configured AI-assisted review, claims checking, or marketing monitoring yourself is a significant plus.

- A strong sense of urgency. You treat the launch date as a real constraint, and you would rather give a clear answer today with the caveat attached than a perfect one after the campaign has shipped.

- Working command of the advertising rule set: UDAAP, TILA/Reg Z advertising and trigger terms, ECOA/Reg B, FCRA advertising and prescreen, FTC endorsement guides and substantiation expectations, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM.

- Excellent written communication in both languages, and the ability to influence without authority.

We're Also Looking For

- Credit-building, credit reporting, or subscription financial product experience; managing a bank partner's marketing approval process; fair lending exposure in advertising and audience targeting; or hands-on use of marketing compliance monitoring platforms such as PerformLine, any of these is a plus.

- CRCM, CIPP/US, or a JD is a plus and not required.

If you meet most of this, we'd like to hear from you.

Compensation

Base salary is location-based and will be determined by factors including market location, experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to competitive cash compensation, this role is eligible for equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

$115,000 — $170,000 USD

jobs.description:

Senior HR Business Partner, Engineering & Data

Kikoff is looking for a Senior HR Business Partner to support Engineering and Data — a 50+ person team at the center of a profitable, pre-IPO consumer fintech — and to lead the AI-driven evolution of how we run the People function. This is not a traditional HRBP role. You will operate as a product manager for the employee experience, designing, building, and maintaining AI-powered workflows and agents across the full employee lifecycle. You will also be the embedded People partner to the CTO's Chief of Staff, engineering and data leaders, and the managers who run our day-to-day delivery.

Your success will be measured through quantifiable improvements in talent outcomes, the quality and reliability of the AI workflows and agents you build, and your ability to influence culture and organizational effectiveness through data-driven insights. This role reports to the VP of People and works in close partnership with CTO and his Chief of Staff. You'll also collaborate with Recruiting, People Analytics, and People Operations on the systems that run underneath this work. This is a senior individual contributor role — no direct reports — with significant ownership over how Engineering and Data operate as a team.

What You'll Do

- Operate as a product manager for the employee experience. Own the build, launch, and maintenance of AI-powered workflows and agents across the lifecycle moving us from multi-week HR cycles to fast, automated ones

- Architect the foundational talent systems for Engineering and Data: career ladders, and promotion criteria, including the technical and behavioral expectations at each level

- Drive comp planning end-to-end (merit, equity refresh, promotion increases, out-of-cycle adjustments) and coach managers through the full performance lifecycle, including the harder calibration and feedback conversations

- Build automated dashboards and predictive analytics that let leadership make evidence-based decisions on engagement, attendance, learning ROI, retention risk, and high-potential identification

- Own employee relations for the Eng and Data populations — investigations, performance management, accommodations, and sensitive transitions — coordinating with Legal and the VP of People

- Partner with Recruiting on workforce planning, role architecture, leveling decisions, and offer construction for senior technical roles, and support immigration cases (H-1B, green card, wage-weighted lottery) with our external counsel

- Use data to shape policies on remote work, time off, and professional development, and build manager development and skill-gap-driven programs for Eng and Data leaders

- Support IPO readiness workstreams that touch the Eng and Data populations, including workforce compliance, equity education, and SEC-required disclosures

About You

- 5+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3 years in an HRBP role at a venture-backed tech company, with deep experience partnering with technical functions — ideally Engineering, Data, or Product. An advanced degree in Industrial & Organizational Psychology, HR, Business Analytics, or a related field is a plus

- A builder with a product mindset — comfortable writing PRDs, managing a backlog, and iterating on tools and agents. You ship, learn, and improve rather than wait for perfect conditions

- An AI-forward practitioner who has moved past using AI to answer questions and is actively building automation into the way HR work gets done

- Strong analytical and statistical skills, with hands-on experience in HR analytics tooling. Comfortable building models that go meaningfully beyond survey averages and headcount reports

- Fluent in technical comp and engineering leveling frameworks (IC ladders, management tracks, dual-track architectures), with a point of view on what makes them hold up under real-world calibration

- A first-principles thinker — comfortable challenging traditional HR "best practices" when data or technology suggests a better path

- Direct experience partnering with senior technical leaders (CTO, VPE, Director-level engineering managers) as a trusted partner, not a service provider, including the judgment calls that come with employee relations work — investigations, accommodations, terminations

- You read situations the way a good manager would — you can tell when an ER case is really about a manager problem, when a comp request is really about a title problem, and when a "process" complaint is really about something else

We're a small, ambitious team, and we lean on AI to move faster than our size would suggest: generating and iterating on creative, building segmentation logic, spinning up campaigns, and pulling and interrogating our own data. We're looking for someone who will define what best practice looks like here rather than inherit it from a previous playbook. We're looking for data-driven problem solvers with a growth mindset, willing to stretch their comfort levels, move quickly with attention to detail, and do big things. We have an ambitious mission to educate folks about the importance of their credit scores and encourage them to unlock their financial access.

What you'll own:

- Be a thought leader for lifecycle at Kikoff — setting the strategy and standards the team executes against, and raising the bar on what we test and how we measure it

- Expand our lifecycle programs to deepen engagement across a growing feature set, identifying where new products and use cases create untapped opportunities to drive value

- Increase retention and drive higher customer lifetime value

- Ship and test at high volume, running a rigorous split-testing program that produces conclusive results rather than directional signals

- Build AI-assisted workflows into how the team operates — creative production, audience building, campaign QA, performance summarization, post-test analysis — so the program's output compounds without growing headcount

- Advance our personalization capabilities from rules-based branching toward model-driven content selection, delivering the most relevant message to each user at the moment it will land best

- Improve the segmentation, cadence, timing, and touchpoint mix of our comms

- Mentor junior teammates through direct feedback, reusable frameworks, and leading by example

Who you are:

- 5+ years driving toward growth goals under set targets and timelines in a lifecycle or CRM role

- A thought leader others look to for the point of view — you've shaped lifecycle strategy for an organization, not just executed against someone else's roadmap

- A fast-moving, detail-oriented, data-driven executor with an ownership mindset

- Deep hands-on experience with Iterable, Braze, Customer.io, or similar CRM tools

- Fluent with AI tools in your day-to-day workflow — you've used them to write, analyze, build, or automate, and you have opinions about where they work and where they don't

- Robust experience working with customer and user event data, and marrying it to well-designed, targeted campaigns

- Able to define key marketing KPIs and break them down into their underlying drivers to understand and influence performance from first principles

- Comfortable juggling multiple projects and executing on schedule at high velocity

- Strategic thinker able to break down and organize problems, assess opportunity areas, and develop big ideas and priorities to move the business forward

- Understanding of hypothesis-driven A/B, MVT, and holdout testing, with the ability to analyze results and pull out learnings that inform future tests

- Strong instincts for direct response creative, and a framework for adjusting based on experimentation

- SQL proficient — you pull your own data and cross-validate your own results

- Experience in fintech or D2C is a bonus

Why Kikoff:

Kikoff exists to expand access to financial opportunity. Product marketing here means you're directly accountable for how customers understand and experience what we build. You'll have real ownership, close partnership with product, and the opportunity to do work that genuinely improves people's financial lives.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Development Enterprise
jobs.description:
Kikoff: The Fintech Powering Financial Security at Scale
Kikoff is a profitable, pre-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money.
We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially.

Why Kikoff:

This is a consumer fintech startup, and you will be working with serial entrepreneurs who have built strong consumer brands and innovative products. We value extreme ownership, clear communication, a strong sense of craftsmanship, and the desire to create lasting work and work relationships. Yes, you can build an exciting business AND have real-life real-customer impact.

Senior Manager, Business Development - Enterprise

About the Team

Kikoff Enterprise helps businesses turn credit progression into a driver of customer and business growth. Through Kikoff's embedded credit products and infrastructure, partners can help their customers build stronger credit while creating opportunities to expand eligibility, deepen engagement, improve retention, and unlock access to additional financial products.

The Business Development team is responsible for bringing this value proposition to market. We identify strategic partners, understand the business problems they are trying to solve, design solutions using Kikoff's Enterprise platform, and build the commercial relationships required to bring those solutions to life.

Our partners span financial institutions, lenders, fintech and embedded finance platforms, gig economy companies, and other large consumer businesses. Partnerships can range from embedding Kikoff's credit-building products into a partner's customer experience to powering critical credit infrastructure such as bureau furnishing, decline recovery, dispute management, decisioning, and credit progression.

The team works closely with executive leadership and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Finance. By joining this team, you will play a key role in defining and scaling Kikoff Enterprise as a major growth engine for the company.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Business Development to help define and scale Kikoff's Enterprise business.

This is a highly strategic role responsible for developing some of Kikoff's largest and most consequential partnerships. You will own complex opportunities from initial strategy and executive engagement through commercial agreement, launch, and long-term expansion.

Rather than selling a predefined product, you will develop a deep understanding of a partner's business, identify where credit progression and Kikoff's infrastructure can create meaningful economic value, and architect solutions that benefit both the partner and its customers.

You will be expected to develop strong points of view on new markets, partners, and business models; build the business case for pursuing them; and mobilize teams across Kikoff to turn those opportunities into scalable businesses.

As a senior member of the Enterprise team, you will also help shape Kikoff's go-to-market strategy, influence the Enterprise product roadmap, establish best practices for strategic partnerships, and serve as a trusted partner to senior executives both internally and externally.

Why Join the Kikoff Business Development Team

- Help build a major new business at Kikoff. Enterprise represents an opportunity to extend Kikoff's products and infrastructure to millions of consumers through some of the largest financial and consumer platforms.

- Own high-impact strategic partnerships. Work on relationships that can materially influence Kikoff's distribution, product strategy, and long-term growth.

- Create value beyond distribution. Help partners use credit progression to expand their addressable markets, recover declined customers, deepen engagement, improve product eligibility, increase retention, and unlock new revenue.

- Shape the strategy, not just execute it. You'll help determine which markets Kikoff enters, which partners we prioritize, and how we structure new Enterprise products and business models.

- Work directly with senior leadership. This role operates across executive teams at Kikoff and our partners and has significant visibility throughout the organization.

- Take proven capabilities into new markets. Build enterprise businesses around Kikoff's consumer products, credit infrastructure, data, and technology.

- Grow with the organization. As the Enterprise business expands, this role has meaningful opportunity to take on broader commercial and team leadership.

What You'll Do

- Own Kikoff's most strategic and complex Enterprise opportunities from market development and executive engagement through negotiation, launch, and long-term expansion.

- Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses, customers, economics, strategic priorities, and product roadmaps to identify where Kikoff can create differentiated value.

- Build and maintain relationships with senior executives across banks, credit unions, lenders, fintechs, embedded finance platforms, and large consumer businesses.

- Develop tailored partnership strategies that connect Kikoff's capabilities to partner objectives such as market expansion, customer acquisition, credit eligibility, decline recovery, engagement, retention, cross-sell, and monetization.

- Build sophisticated business cases and commercial models that quantify the value of a partnership for both Kikoff and the partner.

- Lead complex negotiations involving partnership economics, product scope, integrations, data, go-to-market strategy, and long-term commercial structures.

- Identify and develop new industries, channels, use cases, and partnership models that can materially expand Kikoff's addressable market.

- Develop points of view on market opportunities and make recommendations to Kikoff's leadership team regarding where the Enterprise business should invest.

- Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to translate market opportunities and partner needs into scalable Enterprise products and infrastructure.

- Influence Kikoff's Enterprise roadmap by identifying recurring partner needs and distinguishing between strategic platform capabilities and one-off customization.

- Lead cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Growth to move complex partnerships from concept to launch.

- Own the strategic growth of major partners after launch, identifying additional products, customer segments, distribution opportunities, and commercial models.

- Establish executive-level operating rhythms and business reviews with strategic partners to drive accountability and identify opportunities for expansion.

- Serve as a senior voice of the market internally, bringing competitive intelligence, partner feedback, and emerging industry trends into Kikoff's product and corporate strategy.

- Help establish the processes, frameworks, and operating principles required to scale Kikoff's Enterprise partnership organization.

- Mentor and support more junior members of the Business Development team and raise the overall quality of strategic thinking, deal execution, and partner management across the organization.

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree and 6-8+ years of experience across business development, strategic partnerships, fintech, financial services, corporate development, management consulting, investment banking, or similarly strategic and analytical roles.

- Strong fintech or financial services background, with a sophisticated understanding of the ecosystem across consumer credit, lending, banking, embedded finance, payments, or financial infrastructure.

- Demonstrated experience developing and managing strategic relationships with financial institutions, fintech platforms, lenders, or other complex and regulated businesses.

- Track record of originating, structuring, negotiating, and scaling large, complex partnerships with meaningful commercial impact.

- Experience working directly with senior executives and the ability to establish credibility quickly with C-suite and business-unit leadership.

- Exceptional strategic and commercial judgment, with the ability to understand how a partner's business works, identify where Kikoff can create value, and turn that insight into a scalable partnership.

- Experience with B2B and/or B2B2C, embedded finance, API-based, platform, or other ecosystem business models.

- Strong consultative approach and the ability to lead discovery around a partner's business problems rather than relying on a predefined product pitch.

- Advanced quantitative and financial skills, including experience building business cases, financial models, market-sizing analyses, and complex commercial structures.

- Strong negotiation skills and experience navigating deals involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and complex product or regulatory considerations.

- Ability to influence Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Go-to-Market teams without direct authority.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex business and technical concepts into clear executive-level narratives.

- Experience identifying and developing entirely new markets, channels, products, or partnership models is strongly preferred.

- Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity, forming a point of view with imperfect information, and driving an organization toward action.

- Demonstrated leadership and ability to mentor other team members, establish best practices, and raise the quality of execution across a growing organization.

- Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot, ZoomInfo, PitchBook or CB Insights, Tableau, Amplitude, Snowflake, and modern AI tools is a plus.

Base Range
$170,000 — $198,000 USD

Kikoff’s Rotational Associate Manager Program Recent Grad 2027

Associates will participate in multiple rotations, gaining hands-on experience, mentorship from senior leaders, and specialized training designed to fast-track their careers.

About Kikoff: Kikoff is a fintech unicorn offering credit-building solutions that are radically affordable, accessible, and effective. Our core product, the Kikoff Credit Account, is helping over a million customers build better credit. Kikoff has been featured by Nerdwallet, Forbes, Buzzfeed, Business Insider, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others; and our app has a 4.9 rating amongst hundreds of thousands of reviews. But Kikoff is more than just a credit builder: we are a long-term financial partner for our customers, and we have an exciting product roadmap of solutions to help our customers reach their financial goals.

Program Structure:

Initial Training Rotation (~1 month): Associates will experience hands-on training across multiple teams, including Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Business Development. This period focuses on foundational training, business acumen, and industry-specific knowledge.

Focused Rotations: Following the training period, associates will be matched to specific teams based on their skills, interests, and business needs. Associates will then complete two rotations (approximately 6 months each), allowing deeper exposure, responsibility, and impactful contributions within each area.

Potential Rotational Areas:

- Product Marketing: Learn how we position, message, and launch products to customers, gain insights into our users and shape the product roadmap.

- Growth Marketing: Drive user acquisition or increased user retention and monetization through data-driven marketing strategies and experimentation.

- Business Development: Build partnerships, negotiate deals, and identify new growth opportunities for Kikoff.

- Lifecycle Marketing: Analyze customer data, map journey touchpoints, and execute personalized messaging campaigns to drive growth for Kikoff.

What You’ll Gain:

- Comprehensive training across essential business disciplines

- Mentorship from senior leaders and industry experts

- Hands-on experience managing impactful projects

- Clarity in career direction with pathways to future leadership roles

- A supportive, dynamic work environment in an innovative fintech company

Ideal Candidates:

- Current undergraduate and master's students or early career professionals with high potential, such as those from consulting or investment banking

- Highly motivated, curious, and adaptable individuals

- Excellent communication, analytical, and first principles problem-solving skills

- Demonstrated leadership potential and eagerness to learn

- Strategic thinker able to break down and organize problems, assess opportunity areas, and develop big ideas and priorities to move the business forward.
